text: Based on the evidence from NASA FIRMS, there were no thermal anomaly detections within the asset boundary between October 4, 2026, and November 3, 2026. All sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) covered the asset every day during this period. Therefore, it is unlikely that the asset was affected by a significant fire during this time. However, small, short, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may not have been detected.
